reward: pure GT-conditioned Decisions preferences; no R0 anywhere in training selection or reward
pairing: seeded uniform permutation of four candidates, two disjoint pairs, both presentation orders
labels: Official choice A/B/C/D; modal probability>=0.60 and modal margin>=0.20; same physical winner across orders only
consensus: same physical winner in both orders gives +1/-1; others 0
no_signal: zero advantage for tied groups; all-global-batch ties skip optimizer, consume scheduled batch, explicitly count actual updates
baseline_comparison: same SFT and same 3200 scheduled windows; evaluate fixed final batch200; do not select checkpoint by test
presentation: v2 grouped chronological Reference/A/B, full 10 frames each; A/B swapped in second request
network: Shared filesystem queue, gateway API service; GPU workers do not need credentials or API egress
